reasons.action: The brief explicitly requests a performed behavior — the car pulls forward — so action is request-governed; the audio reference is non-visual and cannot supply it.
reasons.medium: No visual reference was supplied, so the rendering medium is request-governed; the audio-only reference carries no visual-medium authority.
reasons.wardrobe: No visual reference exists to inherit clothing or accessory properties from, and none is specified, leaving wardrobe request-governed.
reasons.lighting: "Out of the dark" describes a state of illumination with no visual reference to override, so lighting remains request-governed.
reasons.framing: No camera composition is supplied by any visual reference, so framing is request-governed; the 16:9 canvas and forward motion do not themselves dictate a shot.
reasons.palette: With no visual reference to preserve grading or tone from, the scene's color and tonal treatment is request-governed; "the dark" implies tonal darkness without a conflicting reference.
